categories.name: belongings
categories.rules: For the fictional household of Odette Marlowe: individual movable possessions or groups of possessions, their identification, valuation, or disposal; photographs of such objects. A workshop building itself belongs in workshop.

categories.name: history
categories.rules: For the fictional household of Odette Marlowe: memories, tributes, family photographs, and biographical records. A historical document needed for a current property transaction belongs to the relevant property category.

categories.name: legal
categories.rules: For the fictional household of Odette Marlowe: court filings, property disputes, lawyer correspondence and lawyer invoices. Exclude tax returns and bank statements.

categories.name: money
categories.rules: For the fictional household of Odette Marlowe: account statements, account closures, general bills and payments. Lawyer invoices belong in legal. Property maintenance goes to residence or workshop. Tax-preparation records belong in taxes.

categories.name: notes
categories.rules: For the fictional household of Odette Marlowe: cross-topic research notes and annotated reading. A document whose subject clearly belongs to a specialized destination goes there instead.

categories.name: residence
categories.rules: For the fictional household of Odette Marlowe: the Rivermouth rental house, tenants, repairs, property taxes, insurance, and sale. Records explicitly for preparing income tax returns go to taxes.

categories.name: taxes
categories.rules: For the fictional household of Odette Marlowe: returns, tax forms, and records explicitly gathered for preparing a tax return, including rental income and workshop expenses. An ordinary property bill is not tax preparation just because it includes tax.

categories.name: workshop
categories.rules: For the fictional household of Odette Marlowe: the Greenhollow workshop building, its repairs, sale, and building photographs. Individual movable objects go to belongings; records explicitly for tax preparation go to taxes.

decisions.reason: Court hearing notice for a boundary dispute. Legal category explicitly covers 'court filings, property disputes'.
Bank account closing statement. Money category covers 'account statements, account closures'.
Rental income and expenses assembled expressly for tax return preparation. Taxes category explicitly covers 'records explicitly gathered for preparing a tax return, including rental income'.
Repair invoice for Rivermouth rental house boiler. Residence category covers 'repairs' at the rental property; money category excludes 'Property maintenance' which routes to residence/workshop.
Building inspection of Greenhollow workshop before sale. Workshop category covers 'the Greenhollow workshop building, its repairs, sale, and building photographs'.

Photograph and inventory of portable violin with valuation for sale. Belongings category covers 'individual movable possessions, their identification, valuation, or disposal; photographs of such objects'.
Family remembrance and biographical content about Odette Marlowe's interests. History category covers 'memories, tributes, family photographs, and biographical records'.
Cross-topic research notes comparing document management systems for household administration. Notes category covers 'cross-topic research notes and annotated reading'.
Attorney invoice for property dispute case work. Legal category covers 'lawyer correspondence and lawyer invoices'; money category explicitly excludes lawyer invoices.

Old deed to Rivermouth rental house needed for current sale. Residence category covers the rental property and its sale; history rule notes that historical documents needed for current property transactions route to the relevant property category.
Generic travel advertisement with no connection to Odette Marlowe's household. Does not match criteria for any category, which are all defined for the household of Odette Marlowe.
Research notes on selecting cloud storage for household documents. Fits notes category as cross-topic research affecting document administration across household topics.
